title: Update PM Persona and Shared Partial to Remove Spec File Verification
description:
**Plan Context:** Eliminate the `work/WP-###.md` spec files and `work.md` summary index from the ledger workflow, making the ledger the sole source of WP specification content via `ledger_get_work_package`.

**Description:** Remove the "Spec File Verification" operational protocol from the PM persona and remove the AC content fidelity cross-check and spec file entries from the PM shared partial (`pm-output-format.md`).

**Scope:**
- `personas/ledger/src/content/2-project-manager.md` — "Spec File Verification" protocol section, spec file references
- `personas/shared/partials/pm-output-format.md` — AC fidelity check, file layout diagram

**Deliverables:**
- "Operational Protocol — Spec File Verification" section removed entirely from PM persona
- All references to `work/<WP-ID>.md` and `work.md` removed from PM persona content
- The `work_package_file` note in `ledger_create_work_package` call guidance removed from PM persona
- PM step 10 ("Verify WP spec files") removed or updated to remove spec file verification gate
- AC content fidelity cross-check sub-bullet removed from `pm-output-format.md` (line 14)
- `work.md` and `work/WP-###.md` entries removed from the file layout diagram in `pm-output-format.md` (line 23)
- Verification section simplified to only check ledger state via tools

**Estimated Complexity:** Medium

**Rationale:** The "Spec File Verification" protocol and AC fidelity cross-check exist solely because two sources (spec file and ledger) can drift. With one source (the ledger), these checks and their token cost disappear.

**Code Observations:** The PM persona (`personas/ledger/src/content/2-project-manager.md`) has the "Spec File Verification" heading at line 49 and the verification step reference at line 144. Additionally, lines 55-56 reference `work.md`. The shared partial (`personas/shared/partials/pm-output-format.md`) has the AC fidelity check at line 14 and the file layout entry at line 23.

The verification section in pm-output-format.md only references ledger tools, not filesystem reads.
